column5: 20 zones: ParkGO zones Ia and Ib (since 2026-10-01 digitised from the city's fee zone map of 2025-11-26 with the southern part of Ia after the Amtsblatt annex of 2024-04-30, owner-supplied package, spec Amendment C1; parking_zones_2026_municipal_qa.csv), five BgA car parks (since 2026-10-07, spec Amendment D1, digitised from the annex maps of the Amtsblatt 2022 Nr. 16: Markthalle, An der Martinikirche, Jodutenstrasse/Klint, Suedstrasse and Willy-Brandt-Platz; Kannengiesserstrasse is removed, a pocket park since April 2026), resident concept Stadthalle (zone 132) and its three Parkscheininseln (street_paid), six TU campus areas (since 2026-10-07, ruling R-4a-8, the union per campus of the campus grounds of the v1 release, the OSM university outline where the buildings are, and the red camera detection zones of the GB3 campus maps, the paid car parks: Zentralcampus, Campus Nord, Beethovenstrasse, Langer Kamp (its grounds include the car parks at the International House, whose v1 zone is merged into it), Forschungsflughafen and, new, Volkmaroder Strasse, which has no campus grounds and is its detection zone alone, ticketed from 2026-10-01), three DB BahnPark station car parks at the Hauptbahnhof (since 2026-10-08, spec Amendment G1, owner decision: the station car parks are public, so rulings R-4b-4 and R-4b-9 are revoked for them: P1 Nord bs_hbf_p1_nord, P2 Sued bs_hbf_p2_sued and P3 West bs_hbf_p3_west, each the area within 50 m of the OSM outline of the lot, P1 cut against the BgA lot Willy-Brandt-Platz that borders it; tariffs read from the Contipark pages; not modelled: the Kiss&Ride and evening tariffs of P1 and the BahnCard and Pcard discounts; the free street parking west of the station stays unzoned). ParkGO zone II needs no area zone (spec Amendment D1): the city's phone-parking map of 2024 shows paid city parking outside the Okerumflut only at the three Stadthalle Parkscheininseln (zone 381002, zones of their own) and at the BgA car park Willy-Brandt-Platz (381003); the ParkGO annex map could not be georeferenced to an RMS of 10 m or better and the rule-based constructions of v2 lever 1 and Amendment B found no zone II core (parking_zones_2026_qa.csv, parking_zones_2026_supply_share_qa.csv). Not zoned: resident zones 120B (Helmstedter Strasse) and 330B (TU Hauptcampus), where resident streets alternate with unrestricted free streets so a whole-quarter resident zone would overstate costs (follow-up: street-level digitisation); the permit districts A/B/C, which are no fee zones but the second layer parking_resident_districts_2026 that overlays Ia/Ib (spec Amendment C3: a stay inside the district of the person's home is free); the TU campus Bevenroder Strasse (its detection zone is digitised, but no GB3 page states ticketing). Park-and-ride car parks are free (parken-in-der-innenstadt.php).

column4: parking_tariffs_2026.csv; ParkGO of the Stadt Bad Harzburg (2021); https://www.bad-harzburg.de/service/parkmoeglichkeiten
column5: 5 zones (spec Amendment D3, 2026-10-07): the car parks Sole-Therme, Kurpark, Grossparkplatz, Burgberg and Berliner Platz, each the area within 50 m of its OSM outline; the tourism page names them as paid. The rate is the ParkGO ceiling of 0.50 EUR per started 30 min at every car park (the site rates are not verified), the fee window is ASSUMPTION F1 8-18 h and the maximum stays of 6 h and 10 h are not modelled. The Grossparkplatz lies in the gemeindefreies Gebiet Harz of the municipality polygons (a declared exception, parking_zones_2026_municipal_qa.csv). Three more sites of an attraction page (harzventure.de) have no geometry and no join to a car park and are not zoned. No complete inventory: other paid areas of the town are unknown (assumption Z1).

column5: 4 zones: Altstadt zone 1 (centre approximation; the rule-based core of v2 lever 1 (2026-09-30) was rejected, parking_zones_2026_qa.csv; the majority rule of v2 Amendment B was not applied: its pre-registered validation B5 failed at the share 0.5, and at the owner's post hoc share 0.3 (owner decision 2) the holdout check H2 failed, parking_zones_2026_supply_share_qa.csv) and, since 2026-10-07 (spec Amendment D3, controller ruling R-D3-a), the three car parks at 1 EUR/h (Baeringerstrasse, Klubgartenstrasse/ZOB, Glockengiesserstrasse), each the area within 50 m of its outline in the city's ArcGIS service (2018) with its own fee window from the GOSLAR service page; the Glockengiesserstrasse zone is cut out of zone 1. Zone 2 (fringe, 1 EUR/h) is not digitised: no official boundary is published, the package of 2026-10-07 excludes a modelled ring of unknown source, and the three car parks are facility records without a confirmed zone-2 membership. Cross-check (spec Amendment C4): the zone-1 polygon is compared with the resident and facility areas of the city's ArcGIS service Bewohnerparken (last edit 2018-11-22) in parking_zones_2026_municipal_qa.csv. The resident areas A, B, C, F, G, H and J of that service are the districts of the second layer parking_resident_districts_2026 (spec Amendment C3).

No zone: no site has both a geometry and a sourced short-stay tariff (spec Amendment D3). Parking is free there by assumption Z1.
